name: Stockholm Nordtech Group AB
summary: Stockholm Nordtech Group AB is a private equity firm specializing in growth capital. The firm focuses on acquiring and developing niche software companies and supporting their long-term growth and also focuses on small and medium-sized SaaS companies, technology, B2B software companies, vertical markets, business process management, ecommerce, education, financial management, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, manufacturing, requirements management, retail and supplier integration solutions. The firm typically invests in the Nordic region.
